evidence: Aydin--Belghith--Idowu--Nguyen--Tran, arXiv:2606.08750, full primary preprint, Table 5.
correctness.rationale: The primary source's Table 5 confirms the exact length, type, Lee distance and generator string. I inspected the exact package certificate and verifier and independently replayed the core exhaustive construction from the source string: the negacyclic ideal has 4096 words and 1024 two-torsion words, minimum Lee weight 16, and exactly the stored weight distribution. Its Gray image has 4096 words and binary rank 12, hence is linear, and direct checking confirms cyclic closure after the stated coordinate reorder. The package additionally verifies the binary polynomial gcd and all dual column-dependency cases through weight four.
risks: The independent replay rechecked the complete quaternary census, Gray rank, weight distribution and cyclic closure; the package's exact polynomial-gcd and dual-distance routines were inspected rather than reimplemented in a second software stack.

source_inspections.title: New Codes from Cyclic and Negacyclic Codes of Even Length over Z4
source_inspections.trigger: Exact source of the record-breaking code.

evidence: Complete exact invariant package for the distinguished Table 5 record-breaker.
value.rationale: The object is not an arbitrary small code: it is a newly published record-breaking negacyclic code. Binary linearity of its Gray image, complete weight distribution, cyclic generator and dual distance are standard structural invariants that a coding-theory researcher could directly use for identification, comparison, decoding or further constructions.
risks: No general statement about the other 729 new negacyclic codes is made.

final_claim: The record-breaking length-36 negacyclic \(\mathbb Z_4\) code of Aydin et al. with type \(4^2 2^8\), Lee distance 16 and printed generator string 303230323030321210301230123010323210 has a binary linear Gray image of parameters \([72,12,16]\); after the natural 72-cycle coordinate reorder it is cyclic, with the stated degree-60 generator, complete weight enumerator, dual distance 4, and Gray rank and kernel dimensions 12.
limitations: No claim that the binary \([72,12,16]\) image is itself record-breaking.
